subject: Lease compliance report missing IFRS 16 right-of-use asset breakdown
description: We generated a compliance report for our Q4 audit but the IFRS 16 section does not break out right-of-use assets from operating lease liabilities. Our auditors flagged this. We need this separated or we cannot use the report.

subject: Export to Excel drops lease start/end dates for leases over 5 years
description: When we export lease data to Excel for our accountants, any lease with a term over 5 years is missing the start and end date columns. Shorter leases export fine. This is blocking our monthly reporting.

subject: Escalation clause not detected in commercial real estate leases
description: LegalGraph is not picking up rent escalation clauses in our CRE lease portfolio. These are worded as 'annual CPI adjustment' rather than 'escalation'. We have 40+ leases affected and cannot tell which have uncapped adjustments.

subject: Automated report generated wrong lease classification — operating vs finance
description: The system classified three of our finance leases as operating leases in the compliance report. This changes our balance sheet numbers materially. How did this happen and how do we correct past reports?

subject: Salesforce sync not pulling updated lease amendment dates
description: After we amend a lease in LegalGraph, the updated expiry date takes 48+ hours to appear in Salesforce. Our sales team uses Salesforce to track renewal opportunities, so stale data is causing them to miss outreach windows.

subject: Renewal option detection misses 'right of first refusal' language
description: Renewal options worded as 'right of first refusal on reletting' are not flagged as renewal options. Standard renewal language is detected fine. We have missed two renewal windows because of this.

subject: Need to generate consolidated compliance report across all subsidiaries
description: We have 12 subsidiaries each with their own lease portfolios. Right now we have to generate 12 separate reports and manually consolidate. We need a single consolidated report with subsidiary-level drill-down for our group audit.

subject: Dashboard lease expiry timeline does not account for renewal options
description: The portfolio dashboard shows leases expiring based on base term only. It ignores renewal options we have already elected. This makes our 'upcoming expirations' view inaccurate — we show 18 leases expiring in 6 months when it should be 7.

subject: Percentage rent clauses in retail leases not extracted
description: For our retail leases with percentage rent (base rent + % of gross sales), LegalGraph only extracts the base rent figure. The percentage rent trigger threshold and rate are not captured. This understates our actual rent liability.

subject: GASB 87 compliance report needed for government entity clients
description: Two of our clients are government entities and need GASB 87 compliance reports, not IFRS 16. The system only supports IFRS 16 and ASC 842. This is blocking us from serving this segment.

subject: Bulk export of lease abstracts locks up browser for portfolios over 200 leases
description: When we try to export lease abstracts for our full portfolio (240 leases), the browser freezes and the export fails after 3-4 minutes. We have to do it in batches of 50 which is very time consuming.

subject: Cannot map custom lease fields to IFRS 16 disclosure line items
description: We have custom fields for lease incentives and tenant improvement allowances. These do not map to the IFRS 16 disclosure template fields so they are excluded from reports. We need a field mapping configuration screen.

subject: Audit trail for compliance report approvals is incomplete
description: When we approve a compliance report for submission, the audit log shows the approval but not who reviewed it before approval or what version was approved. Our auditors require a complete review chain.

subject: Lease data not syncing from DocuSign after lease execution
description: After a lease is executed via DocuSign, the signed document should auto-import into LegalGraph. This stopped working 2 weeks ago. We now have a backlog of 30 executed leases not in the system.

subject: Subletting restriction clauses flagged with wrong severity
description: Absolute subletting prohibitions and conditional subletting restrictions are both flagged as 'High' risk. Conditional restrictions are usually negotiable and should be 'Medium'. This causes us to escalate too many leases to the GC.

subject: Report scheduling: need reports auto-generated before quarter end
description: We need compliance reports auto-generated 5 business days before quarter end so we have time to review before the audit deadline. Currently we have to manually trigger every quarter and sometimes miss the window.

subject: No way to filter dashboard by lease type (real estate vs equipment)
description: Our portfolio includes both real estate and equipment leases but the dashboard cannot filter by lease type. The metrics are mixed together which makes it hard to report separately to our CFO vs our facilities team.

subject: Force majeure clause detection not working on older lease templates
description: Leases from before 2020 use 'Act of God' language instead of 'force majeure'. These are not flagged. Post-COVID this has become a real issue as we try to assess portfolio exposure.

subject: Need variance explanation when lease liability changes between periods
description: The compliance report shows lease liability changed by $2.3M quarter over quarter but does not explain why — new leases, modifications, terminations, FX. Auditors need a variance bridge.

subject: API rate limits causing partial syncs with our ERP system
description: Our ERP pulls lease data via API every hour. The API rate limit (100 calls/hour) is being hit, causing partial syncs. We need higher rate limits or webhook-based push instead of polling.

subject: Insurance requirement clauses not extracted (only liability limits flagged)
description: The system extracts liability caps but not insurance requirements (types of coverage, minimum amounts, additional insured requirements). Our risk team needs this for insurance portfolio review.

subject: Multi-currency lease portfolio report shows inconsistent FX rates
description: We have leases in USD, GBP, and EUR. The compliance report uses different FX rates for different sections — spot rate in one place, average rate in another. IFRS 16 requires consistent rate application.

subject: Renewal probability score not explained — attorneys don't trust it
description: The dashboard shows a 'renewal probability' score for each lease but there is no explanation of how it is calculated. Our attorneys ignore it because they do not understand the inputs. We need a methodology explanation.

subject: Co-tenancy clauses in retail leases not identified
description: Co-tenancy clauses (where our rent obligation changes if anchor tenants leave) are not extracted at all. We have 15 retail leases with these clauses and no visibility into exposure.

subject: Compliance report submitted to auditors contained prior period data
description: We generated and submitted our Q4 2024 compliance report. Post-submission we discovered it contained Q3 data for 8 leases that had been modified. We need an audit of all generated reports and a data validation check before submission.
